chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jaroud, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'There is nothing more hateful to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than a filled belly.'
ai.seo_question: What is the most hated thing to Allah according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (asws) identifies a 'filled belly' as the most abhorrent state to Allah, a concept deeply rooted in Shia asceticism (Zuhd) where physical satiety is seen as the primary cause of spiritual negligence and the hardening of the heart. This narration serves as a foundational text for the practice of moderate eating, linking physical discipline directly to the cultivation of divine proximity and the removal of barriers to worship.
